FN-4UX8HIR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 88
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/20/2026
Senate Bill 88 as introduced would decrease the administrative obligations of the Division of
Construction Management (DCM) by an undetermined amount, by removing requirements that
DCM: (1) review and inspect exempt projects for compliance with the Americans with
Disabilities Act, and for fire safety and life safety compliance; and (2) issue written compliance
recommendations to K-12 schools or any four-year public institution of higher education, or
their respective governing bodies.

FN-4UX8HIR-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 88
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/01/2026
Senate Bill 88 as reported by the Committee on State Government would decrease the
administrative obligations of the Division of Construction Management (DCM) by removing
requirements that DCM: (1) review and inspect exempt projects for compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act, and for fire safety and life safety compliance; and (2) issue
written compliance recommendations to K-12 schools or any four-year public institution of
higher education, or their respective governing bodies.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of DCM by lowering the threshold
that certain capital improvement projects would be subject to DCM approval from an estimated
project cost of $750,000, under current law, to $300,000, pursuant to this bill.
